title: The Square
previewText:

blocks.html: Area of the Square
blocks.plainText: Area of the Square

blocks.html: If Block D is developed as a single zoning lot, an open area known as “the Square,” with a minimum area of 40,000 square feet, shall be provided, connecting West 130th and West 131st Streets, as shown on Map 7 (Mandatory Open Areas) in Appendix A of this Chapter. This minimum area shall not include either the Midblock Open Area on Block D, or the area of the mandatory widened sidewalks on the West 130th and 131st Street frontages adjacent to the Square.
blocks.plainText: If Block D is developed as a single zoning lot, an open area known as “the Square,” with a minimum area of 40,000 square feet, shall be provided, connecting West 130th and West 131st Streets, as shown on Map 7 (Mandatory Open Areas) in Appendix A of this Chapter. This minimum area shall not include either the Midblock Open Area on Block D, or the area of the mandatory widened sidewalks on the West 130th and 131st Street frontages adjacent to the Square.

blocks.html: The Square shall be used for open space accommodating both passive recreation and limited active recreation.
blocks.plainText: The Square shall be used for open space accommodating both passive recreation and limited active recreation.

blocks.html: Building transparency
blocks.plainText: Building transparency

blocks.html: The bounding building wall on the west side of the Square shall be transparent for 50 percent of the area of such wall, measured from the finished level of the adjacent pavement to the height of the ceiling of the second story.
blocks.plainText: The bounding building wall on the west side of the Square shall be transparent for 50 percent of the area of such wall, measured from the finished level of the adjacent pavement to the height of the ceiling of the second story.

blocks.html: Circulation and access
blocks.plainText: Circulation and access

blocks.html: No fences or gates shall be permitted anywhere in the Square.
blocks.plainText: No fences or gates shall be permitted anywhere in the Square.

blocks.html: An unimpeded pedestrian access, with a minimum width of 15 feet, shall be provided across the Square in a generally diagonal direction in the north/south orientation, connecting the two narrow streets, with both ends located a minimum of 100 feet from the Midblock Open Area on Block D.
blocks.plainText: An unimpeded pedestrian access, with a minimum width of 15 feet, shall be provided across the Square in a generally diagonal direction in the north/south orientation, connecting the two narrow streets, with both ends located a minimum of 100 feet from the Midblock Open Area on Block D.

blocks.html: The Square shall provide unobstructed access from the adjoining sidewalks for at least 50 percent of the length of each street frontage of the Square. No single fixed element, within 15 feet of the street line of the Square, shall have a dimension greater than 15 feet or be higher than 30 inches, measured from the finished level of the adjacent sidewalk. The clear path between obstructions shall be at least three feet; however, to qualify as an unobstructed access that contributes to the 50 percent requirement set forth in this paragraph, a minimum width of five feet is required.
blocks.plainText: The Square shall provide unobstructed access from the adjoining sidewalks for at least 50 percent of the length of each street frontage of the Square. No single fixed element, within 15 feet of the street line of the Square, shall have a dimension greater than 15 feet or be higher than 30 inches, measured from the finished level of the adjacent sidewalk. The clear path between obstructions shall be at least three feet; however, to qualify as an unobstructed access that contributes to the 50 percent requirement set forth in this paragraph, a minimum width of five feet is required.

blocks.html: Elevation of the Square
blocks.plainText: Elevation of the Square

blocks.html: The elevation of the Square shall generally follow the adjacent topography. Within 15 feet of the street line, the elevation of the Square, for a minimum of 50 percent of the length of each frontage on a street, shall have a maximum slope of 1:15. Beyond 15 feet from the street line, all open areas in the Square, including rolling or bermed lawn areas, may vary but shall not be more than five feet above or one foot below the level of the nearest sidewalk or natural topography. Paved areas shall not be higher than two feet above the level of the nearest sidewalk.
blocks.plainText: The elevation of the Square shall generally follow the adjacent topography. Within 15 feet of the street line, the elevation of the Square, for a minimum of 50 percent of the length of each frontage on a street, shall have a maximum slope of 1:15. Beyond 15 feet from the street line, all open areas in the Square, including rolling or bermed lawn areas, may vary but shall not be more than five feet above or one foot below the level of the nearest sidewalk or natural topography. Paved areas shall not be higher than two feet above the level of the nearest sidewalk.

blocks.html: Permitted obstructions
blocks.plainText: Permitted obstructions

blocks.html: No walls or planters shall be higher than 2 feet, 6 inches above the finished level of the nearest adjoining sidewalk. No planters or planter walls shall be higher than 18 inches above the level of the adjacent grade.
blocks.plainText: No walls or planters shall be higher than 2 feet, 6 inches above the finished level of the nearest adjoining sidewalk. No planters or planter walls shall be higher than 18 inches above the level of the adjacent grade.

blocks.html: Permanent structures, such as food or information kiosks, pavilions or public restrooms, may be placed in the Square, provided they do not exceed a height of 20 feet, or occupy more than three percent of the area of the Square.
blocks.plainText: Permanent structures, such as food or information kiosks, pavilions or public restrooms, may be placed in the Square, provided they do not exceed a height of 20 feet, or occupy more than three percent of the area of the Square.

blocks.html: Temporary or movable amenities, including elements such as trellises, movable tables, game tables, play equipment and performance facilities, are permitted, not to exceed 10 percent of the area of the Square.
blocks.plainText: Temporary or movable amenities, including elements such as trellises, movable tables, game tables, play equipment and performance facilities, are permitted, not to exceed 10 percent of the area of the Square.

blocks.html: Seating
blocks.plainText: Seating

blocks.html: A minimum of one linear foot of seating shall be provided for each 50 square feet of the Square. A minimum of 75 percent of the required seating shall be fixed; up to 25 percent may be movable. Every two and one-half linear feet of fixed seating shall be considered as seating for one person.
blocks.plainText: A minimum of one linear foot of seating shall be provided for each 50 square feet of the Square. A minimum of 75 percent of the required seating shall be fixed; up to 25 percent may be movable. Every two and one-half linear feet of fixed seating shall be considered as seating for one person.

blocks.html: The following standards shall apply to all required seating:
blocks.plainText: The following standards shall apply to all required seating:

blocks.html: (a)        fixed seating may be provided in the form of double-sided benches, which shall be a minimum of 36 inches deep;
blocks.plainText: (a) fixed seating may be provided in the form of double-sided benches, which shall be a minimum of 36 inches deep;

blocks.html: (b)        50 percent of the fixed seats shall have backs; such backs shall be not less than 14 inches high;
blocks.plainText: (b) 50 percent of the fixed seats shall have backs; such backs shall be not less than 14 inches high;

blocks.html: (c)        fixed seating shall be between 16 inches and 18 inches in height, with a minimum depth of 18 inches measured from the edge to the back; and
blocks.plainText: (c) fixed seating shall be between 16 inches and 18 inches in height, with a minimum depth of 18 inches measured from the edge to the back; and

blocks.html: (d)        all seating shall be made of durable material and shall be comfortable to sit on, with rounded edges of at least one inch radius.
blocks.plainText: (d) all seating shall be made of durable material and shall be comfortable to sit on, with rounded edges of at least one inch radius.

blocks.html: However, other types of seating, such as the edges of planters and fountains, may count toward the required amount of seating if such seating has a minimum depth of 22 inches and is between 16 and 18 inches in height.
blocks.plainText: However, other types of seating, such as the edges of planters and fountains, may count toward the required amount of seating if such seating has a minimum depth of 22 inches and is between 16 and 18 inches in height.

blocks.html: At least 20 percent of the required seating shall be provided within 15 feet of the street line of the Square fronting all streets and the adjacent Midblock Open Area, and arranged to encourage a variety of uses. If such Midblock Open Area is provided with seating, that frontage of the Square may be exempt from this requirement.
blocks.plainText: At least 20 percent of the required seating shall be provided within 15 feet of the street line of the Square fronting all streets and the adjacent Midblock Open Area, and arranged to encourage a variety of uses. If such Midblock Open Area is provided with seating, that frontage of the Square may be exempt from this requirement.

blocks.html: General requirements for trees and planting
blocks.plainText: General requirements for trees and planting

blocks.html: A minimum of 50 percent of the Square shall be landscaped with soft ground cover. Soft ground cover shall include trees, grasses, shrubs and other ornamental planting material. The remaining 50 percent of the Square may be paved as hard surface.
blocks.plainText: A minimum of 50 percent of the Square shall be landscaped with soft ground cover. Soft ground cover shall include trees, grasses, shrubs and other ornamental planting material. The remaining 50 percent of the Square may be paved as hard surface.

blocks.html: At least 30 percent of the area of the Square shall contain a continuous planting area, with minimum soil depth of five feet. Berming is allowed provided that the height of the berm is not greater than five feet above the level of the adjoining sidewalk.
blocks.plainText: At least 30 percent of the area of the Square shall contain a continuous planting area, with minimum soil depth of five feet. Berming is allowed provided that the height of the berm is not greater than five feet above the level of the adjoining sidewalk.

blocks.html: Trees
blocks.plainText: Trees

blocks.html: A minimum of 38 trees is required. Such trees shall measure at least four inches in caliper at the time of planting, except that trees which are multi-stem varieties shall have a minimum height of eight feet. Trees shall be planted in continuous planted areas that have a minimum depth of four feet and a minimum area of 500 square feet of soil. All trees shall be planted flush to grade. The requirements of this paragraph, (a), shall be in addition to the requirements of Section 104-422 (Midblock Open Areas).
blocks.plainText: A minimum of 38 trees is required. Such trees shall measure at least four inches in caliper at the time of planting, except that trees which are multi-stem varieties shall have a minimum height of eight feet. Trees shall be planted in continuous planted areas that have a minimum depth of four feet and a minimum area of 500 square feet of soil. All trees shall be planted flush to grade. The requirements of this paragraph, (a), shall be in addition to the requirements of Section 104-422 (Midblock Open Areas).

blocks.html: Planting
blocks.plainText: Planting

blocks.html: Seasonal planting is encouraged but not required. When planting beds are provided, they can be counted towards meeting the requirement for soft ground cover. Planting beds shall have a minimum soil depth of two feet for grass or other similar ground cover and three feet for shrubs.
blocks.plainText: Seasonal planting is encouraged but not required. When planting beds are provided, they can be counted towards meeting the requirement for soft ground cover. Planting beds shall have a minimum soil depth of two feet for grass or other similar ground cover and three feet for shrubs.

blocks.html: Other required amenities
blocks.plainText: Other required amenities

blocks.html: Racks shall be provided for a minimum of 16 bicycles. Such racks shall be located in the Square within 10 feet of the street line or, if outside the Square, on any open area facing the Square.
blocks.plainText: Racks shall be provided for a minimum of 16 bicycles. Such racks shall be located in the Square within 10 feet of the street line or, if outside the Square, on any open area facing the Square.

blocks.html: Four drinking fountains, two of which shall be fully accessible for children and people with disabilities, shall be provided in the Square or on the sidewalks, mandatory widened sidewalks or Midblock Open Area adjacent to the Square.
blocks.plainText: Four drinking fountains, two of which shall be fully accessible for children and people with disabilities, shall be provided in the Square or on the sidewalks, mandatory widened sidewalks or Midblock Open Area adjacent to the Square.

blocks.html: Not less than 40 cubic feet of trash receptacles shall be provided. Individual containers shall not be smaller than 25 gallons each. There shall be 10 containers, at least three of which shall be for used for recycling paper, plastic and metal waste. Such recycling containers shall be located in the Square within 10 feet of the street line or, if outside the Square, on any open area facing the Square.
blocks.plainText: Not less than 40 cubic feet of trash receptacles shall be provided. Individual containers shall not be smaller than 25 gallons each. There shall be 10 containers, at least three of which shall be for used for recycling paper, plastic and metal waste. Such recycling containers shall be located in the Square within 10 feet of the street line or, if outside the Square, on any open area facing the Square.

blocks.html: Permitted amenities
blocks.plainText: Permitted amenities

blocks.html: Permitted amenities include such elements as artwork and water features, which may occupy up to 10 percent of the area of the Square.
blocks.plainText: Permitted amenities include such elements as artwork and water features, which may occupy up to 10 percent of the area of the Square.

blocks.html: Public space signage
blocks.plainText: Public space signage

blocks.html: At least four entry and two information plaques shall be provided. The content and design of such signs shall comply with the standards for public space signs set forth in the Zoning Resolution. Information about the Square may be provided on the entry plaques.
blocks.plainText: At least four entry and two information plaques shall be provided. The content and design of such signs shall comply with the standards for public space signs set forth in the Zoning Resolution. Information about the Square may be provided on the entry plaques.

blocks.html: Vents facing the square
blocks.plainText: Vents facing the square

blocks.html: On any building wall adjacent to and facing the Square, exhaust or air intake vents shall be located higher than 15 feet above the level of the Square.
blocks.plainText: On any building wall adjacent to and facing the Square, exhaust or air intake vents shall be located higher than 15 feet above the level of the Square.

blocks.html: Vents and stairs in the Square
blocks.plainText: Vents and stairs in the Square

blocks.html: Exhaust or air intake vents and stair bulkheads shall not be permitted in the Square, except as authorized by the City Planning Commission, subject to the following conditions:
blocks.plainText: Exhaust or air intake vents and stair bulkheads shall not be permitted in the Square, except as authorized by the City Planning Commission, subject to the following conditions:

blocks.html: (a)        the top of the exhaust or intake vent shall be a minimum of 20 feet above the finished level of the adjacent grade;
blocks.plainText: (a) the top of the exhaust or intake vent shall be a minimum of 20 feet above the finished level of the adjacent grade;

blocks.html: (b)        no single element shall be more than 200 square feet; and
blocks.plainText: (b) no single element shall be more than 200 square feet; and

blocks.html: (c)        the aggregate area occupied by all vents and stair bulkheads shall not exceed one percent of the area of the Square.
blocks.plainText: (c) the aggregate area occupied by all vents and stair bulkheads shall not exceed one percent of the area of the Square.

blocks.html: In order to grant such authorization, the Commission shall find that:
blocks.plainText: In order to grant such authorization, the Commission shall find that:

blocks.html: (1)        placement of such elements cannot be reasonably accommodated elsewhere on the zoning lot; and
blocks.plainText: (1) placement of such elements cannot be reasonably accommodated elsewhere on the zoning lot; and

blocks.html: (2)        such vents and stair bulkheads are located so as to minimize impact on the visibility, accessibility and public use and enjoyment of the Square.
blocks.plainText: (2) such vents and stair bulkheads are located so as to minimize impact on the visibility, accessibility and public use and enjoyment of the Square.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the Square.
blocks.plainText: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to minimize adverse effects on the character of the Square.
